Maya (CS): FYI Lodestar flagged onboarding 2 new UX squads + a spike in nightly embedding jobs. They asked if we can support higher concurrent embedding throughput and a dedicated testing window.
Sofia (Lodestar): confirm — two teams (Search UX, Recommendations) start next Monday. Expected 3x nightly embedding volume for batch jobs. Need low-cost option for dev vs prod.
Jasper (AE): good signal. Renewal in 9 months — upsell path if smooth. Let's prioritize a lightweight playbook.
Ravi (Solutions): can we get temporary Dedicated pool or burst? Also want to run private eval on a sensitive dataset for Recs.
Maya (CS): risk: if they hit latency in prod, they might delay expansion. Can we schedule a quick perf run this week? @Ravi
Ravi (Solutions): yes — can do a dry-run Thu 10am PT. Need quota: GPUs for 2 hours + staging keys. If we hit SLOs, propose canary with autoscale ramp.
Jasper (AE): flagged with finance — they'll cover a short-term seat-based bump if we show cost savings vs hosted. I'll message billing.
Sofia (Lodestar): also want enablement: 2x 60-min sessions (ingest pipeline + embedding tuning). Can the enablement team do Tue/Wed next week?
Maya (CS): noted. I'll schedule workshops with eng-ops and Solutions. Also capturing feedback: Sofia prefers a checklist for dev->prod handoff.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll draft a playbook snippet:
```
- run perf harness
- validate embedding batch size 1024
- enable KV cache for prefix reuse
- monitor token/ms and OOM
```
Maya (CS): action items: 1) Ravi perf run Thu 10am 2) Maya schedule enablement Tue/Wed 3) Jasper confirm finance uplift 4) Create support ticket to request temporary Dedicated pool (eng-ops)
eng-ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4921 created for Dedicated pool request, owner @ravi, ETA preliminary allocation in 48h :rocket:
Jasper (AE): thanks all — I'll loop in renewal lead after perf run. :thumbsup:
